review.intent_summary: Check whether the current response matches a declared multiple of an earlier predictor, preserving lineage and withholding values until required evidence is available.

criteria.criterion: A supplied lag and coefficient use the predictor at the declared earlier sample position.
Derived values retain response and predictor source indexes and source cutoffs in lineage.
When requested, the coefficient is fitted once from a declared training prefix and remains frozen.
Samples lacking the earlier predictor or awaiting coefficient training remain unavailable.

verification_evidence: Executed and manually inspected examples/agentic/lagged-response.json: leading values were null, null; supplied coefficient was 2; first usable sample at index 2 had residual 0, response index 2, predictor index 0, and source cutoff 2026-02-03T00:00:00+00:00.
